acceptanceCriteria: Every production SQLDelight driver enables SQLite foreign-key enforcement when opened.
The host integration driver mirrors production enforcement and the orphan-observation test passes.
Invalid child writes cannot leave partial observable state.
No schema, domain contract or unrelated persistence behavior changes.
The specialist does not run Gradle or edit the delivery ledger.
goal: Enable SQLite foreign-key enforcement consistently for Android, iOS and the host integration driver so invalid orphan observations fail atomically, without changing the schema or persistence contracts.
